comments: ADA Watchdog is an evaluation tool, not an overlay: it tests live pages with axe-core and reports what it finds, and never changes the site's content or code. Each report states which WCAG criteria automated testing cannot cover and still need manual review. Accessibility statement: https://adawatchdog.com/accessibility
features: Automated WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA testing (axe-core) of the pages small-business customers use to buy and book: home, product, cart and checkout start.
